discussion.body: Temple of Water. Seat: east cape above Queen's Cove. World aspect: tide, river, rain, ferry law on King's Sea. Iunum treats Water as court etiquette. Breskshire treats it as harvest rain. Sigil: Undertow. Combat: slow, pull, cleanse heat. Civic: ferries keep schedule; drought and flood stay rare. Failure: King's Sea closes as a safe road; Act 4 and later crossings become storm set-pieces; Tierso irrigation dies and pushes blight into Life. Relation: Water cools Fire and carries Mist. Owner NPC: Cove tide-keeper. Party link: Nym, because docks live or die on this aspect.
